claim.value: Test workloads may change the behavior under investigation.
claim.scope: A possible intervention effect, not an observed test-induced change.

provenance.rationale: P033 explicitly identifies test workloads as a possible source of behavioral change.

signal_basis.value: The investigation permits controlled test exports once representative test data and spare capacity are established, and tracks whether the canary changes predicted phase duration and overall tail delay without increasing failures or unfinished exports.
signal_basis.scope: A proposed investigation involving possible added test traffic; measured changes do not themselves establish a test-workload effect.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the controlled-test prerequisites, monitored outcomes and proposed-observation qualification.
The bounded possibility claim is supported without requiring an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Introducing test exports can alter resource use and timing in the system being investigated. Representative data and spare capacity do not guarantee that added workloads leave behavior unchanged. This licenses the stated possibility, without establishing that any observed change was caused by test workloads.
uncertainty: Whether test workloads actually change behavior, and by how much, remains undetermined; the claim asserts only that they may.
